purpose: Define the minimum evidence shape for host-specific ClayCode BASE acceptance. Hosted CI/proxy receipts cannot satisfy this contract. The consolidated V2 target runner is an evidence collector only; a separate strict adjudication receipt must satisfy this contract before WP14 can pass.

wp02_parser_contract.selection_reason: V9/V10 dotted-prefix lookahead makes horizontal trivia semantically active for Needle.owns(X) versus Needle.owns (X). V17 is the minimal declarative V9 successor that excludes call-parenthesis/comment starts from the dotted-prefix RHS lookahead without importing V7/V10/V16 typed-fn or operator-surface changes.
wp02_parser_contract.required_identity_rule: At execution time the collector, strict-LALR receipt and full-corpus frontend receipt must all embed the exact SHA-256 of selected_grammar_path, while the active production canonicalizer must identify the same selected_grammar_path. No predecessor/unified research-candidate receipt can satisfy WP02 unless this contract is explicitly versioned and changed first.
wp02_parser_contract.strict_promotion_rule: Selecting a repair candidate in this contract is not CC-WP-02 PASS. The selected grammar must still pass strict interegular-enabled construction, full admitted G9+Dialect corpus, canonical identity/trivia equivalence and target-host adjudication before promotion.
wp02_parser_contract.executable_slice_separation: Dedicated WP03/pure-compiler typed-fn evidence may retain its separately versioned grammar contract; it must not be relabeled as WP02 declarative strict evidence.

work_package_receipt_rule: Each work package row must contain pass=true, evidence paths/hashes, exact commands or executable test IDs, and no proxy-only evidence as its sole basis.
additional_required_target_discriminator: WP02 strict/full-corpus/canonicalizer evidence is bound to wp02_parser_contract.selected_grammar_path and exact repository bytes
The selected WP02 grammar must preserve horizontal trivia identity for call syntax, including Needle.owns(X) == Needle.owns (X)
real application rows must not inherit proxy acceptance flags
FULL_FRANK_HANDOFF must cover the actual frozen stateful handoff rather than a bounded score/proxy function
hard_rules: collector target host checks must all pass on a clean non-CI non-container checkout
CC-WP-02-PARSER-CANON must use the exact selected WP02 grammar bytes for strict-LALR and full-corpus evidence and the same selected path for the active production canonicalizer
horizontal whitespace must not change admitted call semantics into dotted-prefix relation semantics
every required work package must pass
all ten applications must pass through the production ClayCode chain
GUI_INTERACTIVE must execute an actual Ubuntu interactive/event-loop adapter, not only a hosted headless state proxy
FULL_FRANK_HANDOFF must be the actual frozen FRANK handoff, not only packet_score or another bounded proxy
runtime v0.4 hardening and compiler-to-mainline-runtime bridge must execute on target
semantic/effect differential evidence outranks self-consistent hashes
overall_pass may be true only when every hard rule above is satisfied
